meta.name: Heritage Readers
meta.principle: Interface layer modern (Apple HIG as the base). Content layer period (engraving for narrative, mnemonic spot for drills). Textures live only inside illustration frames. Controls are never pictured as period objects.
meta.colorNote: Every color marked sample:true is a placeholder. Replace it with a value sampled from scans of the 1879 McGuffey Readers (neutrals) and the 1946 Hay & Wingo Reading with Phonics (spot colors) before production. Do not ship approximations.

paper.role: illustration frames only; may carry texture

ochreText.role: ochre as text or icon on parchment (fill ochre fails 4.5:1 for text)

mastered.job: a skill the child has mastered

tutor.job: the tutor's voice, the current rung, the primary action

dark.note: Dark theme for the parent, teacher and admin surfaces at night. The student surface ships light only.

measured.mutedRed on parchment: 6.1:1 (not used as text on the student surface)

literacy.role: content, ages 4 to 6. Single-story a and g, open counters.

book.role: content, ages 7 and up. Shared with the printed readers.

bookDisplay.role: titles inside the content layer, drop caps

drill.note: Hay & Wingo scaffold. One phonogram or word on screen, nothing else.

content.milestone: The move from bandA to bandB is earned (first bandB passage read at 95% accuracy), announced to the child, and reflected in the printed readers.

rules: No italics in body text for bands A and B.
Letter spacing and word spacing are parent-adjustable within +0.05em to +0.2em.
Dynamic Type and VoiceOver supported on every surface.

mastery.role: the one mastery animation. Built once, at full production quality.

rules: The reading-check underline follows ASR word alignment; no color flood.

voice.note: Recorded acoustic cues only. The voice is the sound of the product. No music under reading.

print.page: US Letter, 0.75in margins, hole-punch safe left margin 1.0in

teacherPage.script: Direct Instruction form: say this, have the child do this, if the child errs do this

studentPage.illustration: one mnemonic spot or one engraved vignette, greyscale

print.ink: lampBlack only; spot colors print as greyscale

engraving.medium: end-grain wood engraving look: cross-hatching, stippling, single ink
engraving.composition: vignette with feathered border, never full bleed
engraving.color: lampBlack on paper; one spot color at most

mnemonicSpot.medium: clean line art, two to three spot colors
mnemonicSpot.composition: one isolated object on negative space, no background
mnemonicSpot.reference: Hay & Wingo 1946, early Golden Book illustrators

rules: Character bible with reference sheets for every recurring figure.
Generated with reference-image conditioning; reviewed by the editorial board before use.

components.Passage: The screen. Band type, tap-to-hear per word, reading-check underline, one primary action.
components.Ladder: Vertical schematic, two rails, labeled rungs. States: mastered, current, upcoming, review.
components.DrillCard: One phonogram or word, one mnemonic spot, nothing else.
components.Seal: Engraved medallion for a mastered skill. Carries the phonogram.
components.Shelf: Woodcut spines of real titles read.
components.Mic: Listening state, visible from across the room.
components.Report: Three numbers, two recordings, next three skills, projected date, screen minutes next to paper minutes.
components.PrintPacket: Teacher page, student page, score sheet, from the same lesson object.
